description: A from-scratch rich text editor control for WinUI 3, rendered with Win2D (CanvasVirtualControl / CanvasTextLayout). A port of AvaloniaRichEditor: text/paragraph formatting, tables (nested, colspan/rowspan, resize), inline & block images, hyperlinks, undo/redo, CJK/Korean IME, clipboard (rich/HTML/RTF), page view, print/PDF, find, and drop-in host controls. Byte-compatible .flow document format. Native AOT ready.
releaseNotes: See CHANGELOG.md. 1.2.0 is the first feature release since the 1.0 API freeze. THE PUBLIC SURFACE ONLY GAINS 7 DEPENDENCY PROPERTIES (bindable toolbar/view settings), so upgrading needs no code edits -- but several BEHAVIOURS changed, and two are visible in existing documents. (1) Line spacing is now HWP-style: a multiple of the font size (1.6 = 160%), and a paragraph that sets neither spacing nor line height draws at 160% instead of the font's own ~120%; the default paragraph bottom margin went from 10px to 0. The file format is unchanged, but old documents look more open. (2) A heading's bold and size are now character properties rather than something the renderer forces, so bold can be turned off inside a heading and an explicit size survives; re-applying a heading (even the same level) writes the preset back. Old files are converted once when the editor receives them -- the serializer does not convert, so a host that turns an old file straight into HTML/RTF without an editor gets the character properties as they are. Also: bold/italic/underline/strikethrough now toggle the Word way (all-on means off, otherwise all on) instead of flipping run by run; printing and SavePdf emit real text instead of a bitmap per page, at printer resolution, and the print dialog now opens under Native AOT; LoadJson/LoadPackageAsync reject non-document JSON and zips without document.json (JsonException / InvalidDataException) and keep the open document instead of silently replacing it with an empty one marked saved; page setup starts from the host's defaults instead of inheriting the last document's; AllowImages/AllowTables now also filter rich paste and InsertHtml; links open only http/https (a document's ms-msdt:/search-ms:/ms-settings: link used to launch its handler on one click); the undo budget measures elements rather than characters; and the English label for cell vertical centring is "Middle". New: drag a table or picture to move it (Ctrl to copy), per-axis picture resize handles, single-cell selection (F5) and Shift+arrow cell blocks, a find UI (Ctrl+F/H, F3) with a built-in find bar, vector toolbar icons. Fixes span caret and AltGr key handling, tables, pictures (a stretched picture used to re-decode forever while on screen), links, BOM-prefixed file import, host events and two Native-AOT-only line-metric defects. Copying a picture allocates 352MB -> 160MB. Verification: 391 -> 815 tests, every fix confirmed by falsification.
title: WinUIRichEditor
